description: Log one drive in the mileage log: the date, where from and to, the distance in miles or km, the purpose, and the category (business, medical, moving, charitable, personal). Returns its TR-YYYY-NNNN id. Free tier: 20 trips per calendar month, counted on the month of the trip date.

category.description: One of: business, medical, moving, charitable, personal. Personal trips are kept for the record and priced only if a rate exists

date.description: The day the trip was driven, YYYY-MM-DD. A future date is refused: the trip cannot have been driven yet

distance.description: How far, to the thousandth of the unit, e.g. 12.5

from.description: Where the trip started, e.g. Home office, 14 Nowa Street

jurisdiction.description: Which rate set prices this trip, when more than one jurisdiction has a rate for its category. Omit when only one does

purpose.description: Why the trip was made, e.g. Site visit for the Kowalski refit

to.description: Where it ended, e.g. Client site, 2 Mill Lane

unit.description: miles or km; spellings like mi and kilometre are accepted

name: trip_add
title: Log a trip
